references.role: content inspiration — says/hears depth, not visual family

reference_role.style: Dark charcoal collage plate: matte black field, hot magenta #ff006e accents, fashion-lifestyle cutouts, animals used as emotion, soft gold metal. Not beige cards. Not horror occult table.
reference_role.layout: Dense magazine-collage rhythm that we translate into a strict 3×3 of self-contained 3:4 panels with thin white gutters. Hook cell is scene-first (large type in the picture). Internal cells are 50–60% type with a smaller subject. CTA cell is hero + huge script trigger.
reference_role.typography: Heavy white grotesque for the scene/keywords. Thin magenta handwritten script for the secondary emotional word. Torn-tape / pill blocks for short labels. Type sits in front of and behind subjects. No tiny gray paragraphs.
reference_role.mood: Night-smart, high contrast, slightly dangerous intimacy — a woman who already feels the temperature drop. Fashion, not therapy-office. Magenta heat on cold charcoal.
reference_role.content_inspiration: slide-04 teaches a framed psychological card (Говорит / Слышишь / урок). We keep that DEPTH on save slides 05–07. We do not copy slide-04's old visual family or its original headline.

thin white gutters for Excalibur seam slice

panel archetypes: hero scene (1,9), type+animal (2,4), pill-typography (3), framed save cards (5–7), recap medallion (8)
motifs: torn magenta tape, animal-as-metaphor, Victoria on hook+CTA, optional gold medallion
change: topic metaphors: Saturday eyes / autumn plans vs Tuesday «занят» and silence
copy: locked Gemini RU + EN pair (ТЕПЛО / WARMTH)
domain objects: phone thread, two-phase card, says/hears/reality stack, 3 grounding rules
Victoria wardrobe and pose for THIS pack only

foreign women's faces and collage models

horror table, skulls, blood, dripping candles

thumbnail_test.reads_in_2s_because: One face (Victoria), one cat, one huge white scene line about Saturday eyes, magenta script «Тепло – холодно» / «Hot & Cold», cold phone glow. No mechanic title. No word Сцена. Contrast is charcoal vs white vs #ff006e — readable at ~200px.
thumbnail_test.fail_if: headline is a list title, platinum hair, missing cat, beige wash, or unreadable Cyrillic

save_test.why: 05 is a two-phase card, 06 is a three-layer perception card, 07 is a 3-rule checklist. All are framed. 08 is a keepable rule but secondary to 05–07.
